name: kith-desktop
description: Kith for macOS, Linux and Windows: your coding agents as teammates.

scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types src/shared/*.test.ts src/shared/relay-core/*.test.ts src/renderer/web/*.test.ts src/renderer/lib/*.test.ts src/renderer/components/kith/*.test.ts src/renderer/views/thread/*.test.ts src/renderer/views/call/*.test.ts
scripts.dist:mac:dev: node tools/account-config.mjs dev && node tools/native-host.mjs dev && node tools/native-screen.mjs dev && node tools/native-speech.mjs dev && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config tools/dev-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:mac:main: node tools/account-config.mjs main && node tools/native-host.mjs main && node tools/native-screen.mjs main && node tools/native-speech.mjs main && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux:dev: node tools/account-config.mjs dev && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --config tools/dev-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:linux:main: node tools/account-config.mjs main && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win:dev: node tools/account-config.mjs dev && node tools/native-host.mjs dev && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config tools/dev-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:win:main: node tools/account-config.mjs main && node tools/native-host.mjs main && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
